title: Carry a changed constraint through a proposal and handoff
prompt: Read benchmarks/sources/w2-proposal.md. Write a decision note of at most 160 words covering all fields the source requires. Keep proposals and approvals distinguishable.

acceptance_checks.description: Stage 1 accurately preserves all specified decision-note fields and the pending approval state.
Stage 2 changes the proposed cap to AUD 8,000 without implying sponsor approval or changing the stated duration, count or owner.
Final handoff says AUD 8,000, identifies Alex Chen and the decision sought, and makes pending approval explicit.
No stage invents a start date, production rollout, approval or additional requirement.

lineage_steps: Read benchmarks/sources/w2-proposal.md. Write a decision note of at most 160 words covering all fields the source requires. Keep proposals and approvals distinguishable.
Update the note: the proposed spending cap is now AUD 8,000. Everything else in the source is unchanged. Approval is still pending. Return the revised note.
Using the latest note, write an at-most-100-word handoff for someone who has not seen the discussion. State the owner, scope, current requested cap, approval state and next decision.
